explanation: searchSummaries.ts adds visium to REFERENCE_ATLAS_SOURCES and a regional summary (regionalSummary) for sources whose groups are regions: each region keeps its donor values, sparse flag, spots and compartment, and donors are counted once across regions, so spreadOf is never applied to regions. portalCards.tsx adds the full-row HYPOMAP Visium tile (top five hypothalamic regions, a bar at the donor mean and a dot per donor, sparse marks, unit and tissue-average notes, credit links) and its drill; atlasGap uses absentLabel. search.css styles the wide tile and dots, including the phone layout.
